acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.

must_not: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please rebook RT-3496 within 2028-03-04, 10:00–14:00 UTC and provide the actual collection receipt after pickup, not just a booking status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-033: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. 42 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
